info.description: Tracks all content changes in Strapi

options.comment: Audit log entries are immutable records

contentType.description: The UID of the content type (e.g., api::article.article)

recordId.description: The ID of the record that was modified

userId.description: The ID of the user who performed the action (null for system actions)

username.description: The username of the user who performed the action

userEmail.description: The email of the user who performed the action

changes.description: Object containing field changes (updates) or full data (creates/deletes)

ipAddress.description: IP address of the user who performed the action

userAgent.description: User agent string from the request
